metadata.comparison: 75 real public RTL files: text/no-skill vs MCP/no-skill vs pyslang-verilog-context skill+MCP
metadata.methodology: Each case uses one real public HDL file. Tasks cycle through frontend diagnostic status, design-unit inventory, and first design-unit port count. Text/no-skill uses local text heuristics. MCP/no-skill uses targeted pyslang-mcp tools. Skill+MCP uses parse + diagnostics before the structural query.
